title: A workout or kg challenge can be started when no member uses the app, and nobody can win it
what: Workout and kg challenges count only what members log in the MettleUp app. In the test gym none of its 2 members is linked to the app, yet the owner can start such a challenge, promise free days, and is told "Members see it in the MettleUp app within 10 minutes". The page never says how many members can take part, so the owner waits a month for winners who cannot exist.
expected: Before a workout or kg challenge is saved, the page says how many members use the app (for example "0 of 2 members use the app, so nobody can reach this goal yet") and points to sharing the app link; a check-in challenge needs no such line.
how_often: every workout or kg challenge in a gym where few members use the app
fix_line: Show how many members use the app on the challenge form, and warn when it is none or very few

items.note: Crispy Curves, 2 members: birthday 1/2, phone 2/2, check-in phone 1/2, app link 0/2, plan start and end 1/1, trainer 0/2, batch 0/2.

Birthday and batch are asked by the member form and the import; trainer is picked on the member page; the app link has a share button on every member page; the batch picker hides itself when no member has a batch.
App link is 0/2: challenges (new finding) and diet plans, workout plans, measurements (already found: the screen never says the member is not on the app) depend on it.

Driven in node: the enquiry mobile box turns +91 98765 43210, 919876543210, 09876543210, 0091..., (+91)..., Hindi digits and padded spaces into the right 10 digits and keeps a +44 number for the form to refuse. Name is cleaned before its length check. Dates are the device date picker. The expense amount, measurement, free-days and machine-number boxes refuse Hindi digits or a pasted Rs (already found).
No box in this area cuts a real mobile autofill or paste. Number boxes that refuse Hindi digits or Rs are the two existing findings; nothing wrong is saved.
